decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures that motor shaft and coupling selection must support smooth, centered whisk rotation; no additional update or removal is required.
The centered-shaft criterion does not change the existing splash-control target or mitigation options; the source message's separate splash clause is already represented.
Selecting a shaft configuration for centered whisk rotation does not alter bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or removal clearance.
The shaft criterion is a whisk-configuration constraint and does not change the candidate's existing mixing-quality acceptance criteria.
Whisk shaft centering does not affect the dispensing mechanism or flow behavior; the source message's independent solenoid-flow decision is already represented.
The centered-shaft requirement does not change bowl capacity, size reference, or bowl form.
The whisk shaft configuration has no necessary effect on spout cleaning or fluid-path sanitation requirements.
The source decision does not affect machine branding, wording, or placard placement.
The motor-shaft and whisk-coupling criterion does not alter spout geometry, construction, orientation, or appearance.
Centered whisk rotation does not change the established plumbing seal or liquid-containment requirements.
The source establishes a component performance criterion but does not change the existing off-the-shelf sourcing policy or its documented exception.
The shaft-selection criterion does not necessarily change the system-layout deliverable or the adopted design direction.
